description.en:
The command type.

Valid values:

*   RunPowerShellScript: the PowerShell command.
*   RunBatScript: the Bat command.

The encoding method of the command content and outputs.

Valid values:

*   Base64 (default): returns the Base64-encoded command content and command outputs.
*   PlainText: returns the original command content and outputs in plain text.

description.zh: 云电脑ID。如果指定了云电脑，则查询该云电脑所有的脚本执行记录。
description.en: The cloud computer ID. If you specify a cloud computer, all command execution records of the cloud computer are queried.

description.zh:
云电脑ID列表。

> `DesktopId`参数即将弃用，请使用当前参数传递云电脑ID列表信息。
description.en:
The cloud computer IDs.

>  The `DesktopId` parameter will be deprecated. We recommend using the DesktopIds parameter to specify cloud computer IDs instead.

description.zh: 远程命令在多台云电脑上执行的情况下，是否返回所有云电脑的执行结果。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the execution results of the remote command on all cloud computers when executed across multiple cloud computers.

Valid values:

*   true
*   false

description.zh: 是否在结果中返回脚本运行的输出信息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return command outputs in the response.

Valid values:

*   true
*   false (default)

description.zh: 脚本进程执行ID。取自[RunCommand](~~RunCommand~~)的返回参数。
description.en: The execution ID of the command. You can obtain the value by calling the [RunCommand](~~RunCommand~~) operation.

description.zh: 脚本执行的总执行状态。总执行状态取决于创建执行中的一台或多台云电脑的共同执行状态。
description.en:
The execution status of the command. The value of this parameter is determined by the execution states of the command on all participating cloud computers.

Valid values:

*   Finished: The command execution completes on all cloud computers. Alternatively, the command execution is manually stopped on some cloud computers while it completes on the others.
*   Stopped: The command execution stops.
*   Failed: The command execution failed on all cloud computers.
*   Running: Once there is a command execution in progress, the execution status defaults to Running.
*   PartialFailed: If the command execution failed on part of the cloud computers, the execution status is considered partially failed.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

- 最大值：50。
- 默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

*   Valid values: 1 to 50.
*   Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value that is returned from the last call to the previous DescribeInvocations operation.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available.

title.zh: 查询云助手脚本的执行列表和状态
title.en: Query the execution list and status of Cloud Assistant scripts

descriptions.zh:
- 当您执行命令后，不代表命令一定成功执行，并且一定有预期的命令效果。您需要通过接口返回值来查看实际执行结果，以实际输出结果为准。
- 您可以查询最近2周的执行信息，执行信息的保留上限为10万条。
descriptions.en:
- After you execute a command, it does not necessarily mean that the command was successfully executed or produced the expected effect. You must check the actual execution result based on the return value from the API, and the actual output result prevails.  
- You can query execution information from the past two weeks, with a maximum retention limit of 100,000 records.
